common.formulaHelp: Bhala i-formula ngezinombolo ezivamile, njengo-{typed}: izinombolo zivela njengezinombolo ezincane ngezansi, {shown}. Ukuze uhlanganise izingxenye ze-formula, njengaku-{joined}, khophela leli chashazi:
common.molecularWeight: Isisindo samamolekyuli se-formula eluhlaza (sisetshenziswa kuphela uma i-LOI ingabhalwanga)
common.removeNote: Amaresiphi alondoloziwe agcina ikhophi yawo, ngakho ngeke ashintshe.

material.title: Okokwakha
material.lead: Okokwakha kwakho okuluhlaza, okufakwe njenge-formula yamakhemikhali noma njengokuhlaziywa kwama-oxide.
material.name: Igama
material.weightsNote: Isisindo esilinganayo nesisindo emva kokushiswa kubalwa ku-formula naku-LOI uma ulondoloza.
material.none: Akukabikho okwamanje. Okokwakha okwengeza ngezansi kungangena kumaresiphi akho, eceleni kwalokho okujwayelekile.
material.standardFetchFailed: Kube nephutha ekutholeni ulwazi lokokwakha okujwayelekile.

additive.title: Izithasiselo nokokufaka umbala
additive.lead: Okokufaka umbala nokwenza i-glaze ingabonisi, okulinganiswa ngaphezu kweresiphi eyisisekelo, njenge-cobalt noma i-tin oxide. Iresiphi ingakushiya ngaphandle kwe-unity formula noma ikubale kuyo.
additive.name: Igama
additive.noChemistry: Akunakho ukuhlaziywa kwama-oxide, njenge-stain yasezitolo: kushiye ngaphandle kwe-unity formula
additive.firedNote: Faka lokho okunikeza i-glaze emva kokushiswa: i-cobalt oxide emnyama, {asSold}, iba ngu-{fired} ne-LOI engu-{loi}%. Iresiphi ingabe isiyibala ku-unity formula.
additive.none: Akukabikho okwamanje. Izithasiselo ozengeza ngezansi zingangena kumaresiphi akho, eceleni kwalokho okujwayelekile.
additive.standardFetchFailed: Kube nephutha ekutholeni ulwazi lwezithasiselo ezijwayelekile.
